name: Hélice / ARC CHAIR 02
strategies: rounded-superellipse profile, concentric rings and closed contoured saddle
dual UV surfaces and closed curved lumbar shell
variable elliptical sweep for continuous structural legs and rails
named assembly with typed load-bearing and mortise-tenon joins

geometricFamilies.seat: indexable BufferGeometry with top/bottom and perimeter, leather insert separate
geometricFamilies.backrest: curved closed BufferGeometry skin, 26mm thick, true bilateral surface
geometricFamilies.legs: tapered elliptical sweeps, rear posts continuous above the seat
geometricFamilies.frame: front/rear aprons and bilateral side rails, fitted into posts

structuralRoles.rear-leg-and-stile-L/R: rear feet continuous into back stiles

jointTypes.recessed-edge: back shell captured by rear stile
jointTypes.laminated-seat: leather is embedded in the saddle

provenance.difference: solid suspended lumbar back shell replaces three open splats and crest; reshaped saddle with true inset, measured frame, feet and join sockets
